purpose: Current visitor-map control geometry for staged 3D reconstruction; these are image pixels, not surveyed coordinates.

coordinateSystem.warning: The official map is a perspective illustration. Do not infer metre distances or cadastral boundaries directly from its pixels.

marchToSeptemberPixelTransform.method: SIFT feature matching on map regions, similarity transform fitted by RANSAC
marchToSeptemberPixelTransform.example: The traced dome center [701,679] March becomes approximately [444.92,513.42] September.

geometry.role: Higher-resolution layout image; all coordinates below refer to this exact 1921 x 1081 local image.

currentLegend.role: Later official legend and broad arrangement check. Feature outlines are traced from the March image; September pixels anchor their registration to M5.

features.name: Bahçe görsel dış kenarı
features.notes: Traces the planted exhibit area silhouette above the front parking/road illustration. Some edge segments are obscured by trees and perspective; this is not a legal or surveyed property boundary.

features.name: Giriş–Çıkış
features.notes: Center of the red entrance arrow on the front edge. The gate itself may be offset beneath the entrance building artwork.

features.name: Büyük eliptik kuş kafesi kubbesi
features.notes: The lattice-covered ellipse is visually clear. The #31 Pelikan Göleti marker sits over this dome, whereas #32 Su Kuşları sits just south of it. Confirm the physical association before treating the whole ellipse as either pond or #32 exhibit. The separately documented 70 x 40 m aviary dimensions should govern model scale.

features.name: Pelikan Göleti (#31)
features.notes: The #31 marker is on the lattice-covered ellipse. The pond shoreline is not separately visible beneath the illustrated dome, so no pond polygon is inferred here.

features.name: Giriş Göleti (#5)
features.notes: Visible blue water west and north of the entrance building. Animal icon and number obscure part of the upper shoreline; points there are interpolated.

features.name: Kuzeydoğu ikiz gölet — batı
features.notes: Curving water around the #9 Habeş Maymunu island. Island ring is approximate because its shoreline is covered by trees and labels.

features.name: Kuzeydoğu ikiz gölet — doğu
features.notes: Curving water around the #11 Lemur island. The #11 label and black animal icon obscure part of the inner shore.

features.name: Ana ziyaretçi dolaşımı — savan çevresi
features.notes: A small, representative pedestrian circuit around the large central savanna. The north, west and south arcs follow visible pale path; east connection is partly hidden by landscape and should be checked against imagery or field photos before modeling exact edges or widths.
